name: Canillas de Aceituno (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over white with a purple triangle with its base along the hoist, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Canillas de Aceituno (an olive tree on white with the motto).
history: Municipal flag of Canillas de Aceituno; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre
Canillas de Aceituno arms — olive tree on white, with motto
